text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock E repeatedly just to lock in gains may leave too little invested if it keeps rising; set a deliberate target allocation rather than reacting to the pleasure of a realized gain.","A gain relative to my average cost does not by itself make selling the best choice; compare each holding’s prospects with my overall plan.","I trade rarely, so I should make decisions from the full account and price history, not from short-term account fluctuations or the discomfort of admitting a mistake."]}
